subject: Multigroup cfa using covariance matrix as input with missing values in data

messages.author: cf6f800b12f87d14
messages.subject: Multigroup cfa using covariance matrix as input with missing values in data
parts:
Dear lavaan users,

We are conducting a multigroup CFA using variance-covariance matrix as input, cause the raw dataset is not accessible.

We know that there are some missing values in the dataset. We try to run the following code:

strong.lan <- cfa(model = cfa.model,
                                    sample.cov = sample.cov.list,
                                    missing = "fiml", 
                                    sample.nobs = c(395, 147633), 
                                    group.equal = c("loadings", "intercepts"), 
                                    meanstructure = T),

Question is, how do I tell lavaan that we have missing values in raw data for one of the variance-covariance matrix?

Best regards,
Hsin-Rui Lin

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Multigroup cfa using covariance matrix as input with missing values in data
parts:
We try to run the following code:

strong.lan <- cfa(model = cfa.model,
                                    sample.cov = sample.cov.list,
                                    missing = "fiml", 
                                    sample.nobs = c(395, 147633), 
                                    group.equal = c("loadings", "intercepts"), 
                                    meanstructure = T),
If you want meanstructure=TRUE, you have to provide sample.means= to be reproduced by the model.
Question is, how do I tell lavaan that we have missing values in raw data for one of the variance-covariance matrix?

You can't, that is why raw data are necessary.  FIML calculates the likelihood of observing each row using the portion of the model-implied means and covariance matrix that contain variables on which that row has observations. 

Terrence D. Jorgensen
Assistant Professor, Methods and Statistics
Research Institute for Child Development and Education, the University of Amsterdam
